package service

import (
	"net/http"

	"github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
)

// scenario for service_method_returns_transport_writer_or_gin_h: Services that return `gin.H`, `http.ResponseWriter`, or response-writing helpers.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: warning.
type HealthService struct{}

func (s *HealthService) CheckStatus() gin.H {
	return gin.H{
		"status":  "ok",
		"version": "1.0.0",
		"uptime":  "72h",
	}
}

func (s *HealthService) GetMetrics() gin.H {
	return gin.H{
		"cpu":    45.2,
		"memory": 62.1,
		"disk":   78.3,
	}
}

func (s *HealthService) WriteReport(w http.ResponseWriter, data map[string]string) {
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
	w.Write([]byte(`{"generated": true}`))
}
